title: French Vermicelli Bake
description: A simple yet flavorful casserole made with vermicelli noodles, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook vermicelli noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add Syrian feta cheese and cook until melted and slightly browned.
Stir in chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Add cooked vermicelli noodles to the skillet and toss to coat.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a baking dish.
Top with Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and heated through.
